About us

Founded in 2016, AgNext is a fast-growing AgTech company that aims to solve quality and trust in food value chains by making them safer, transparent and fairer. With digitalization of food quality assessment as our core focus, we offer a uniquely integrated, AI-driven SaaS platform to agribusinesses for automated and instant food quality results. Incubated at IIT Kharagpur, AgNext got its first seed funding from a-IDEA National Agriculture Research in 2017. In the following years, funding was received from Omnivore and Kalaari venture funds as well. Recently, AgNext bagged the largest series A funding in AgTech space by AWI, Falcon Edge Capital. Total Funding: $25 Mn+ Awards & Achievements : - AI Gamechangers award by NASSCOM - Google for startup accelerator program - Finalist in GRAFT Vietnam Challenge 2021 - Most Innovative Agri Startup Award by FICCI - Finalist in Future Food Asia 2020 - Best AgriTech Startup award by Ministry of Agriculture, India in Outlook awards 2020 - Amongst top 5 in Asia by Rabobank, Singapore - Best Innovation Award at ESRI India Summit 2018 - Best Product Award by TiEcon - Agriculture Innovation Award by CII - Upcoming Startup Award by Assocham - MoU with Tea Board of India for AI center of excellence for Tea Phone: +91-8047185818 Email: contact@agnext.com Website: www.agnext.com

Qualix
Food Traceability Software

Qualix is an AI-based rapid quality assessment solution that can instantly assess the quality of commodities & build traceability for businesses at the same time. . Our tech has the ability to do instant on-field analysis for the Grains, Spices & aromatics, Beverages(Tea, milk) & Animal feed. It’s like an MRI for food. In less than 30 seconds, Qualix can analyze every aspect of food that we can trade i.e. the physical quality which uses computer vision technology, a chemical quality that uses spectroscopy, and ambient quality which uses IoT-based technologies for food quality monitoring.

Proud to formalize this collaboration with Indian Institute of Technology, Ropar and ANNAM.AI

Agriculture does not need more pilots that stay in labs. It needs technology that works in mandis, warehouses, processing lines and export yards - where quality decisions are made under time pressure every day.

This partnership brings research depth and field reality together: AI models developed built with millions of data points and validated with IIT Ropar and ANNAM.AI, applied to the quality assurance workflows we already run across commodities, sites and supply chains.

Thank you Prof. Pushpendra P. Singh and the ANNAM.AI team for the shared conviction that AI in agriculture is measured by adoption on the ground, not on papers alone.

Looking forward to the work ahead.

#AgNext #ANNAMAI #IITRopar #AIForAgriculture #DigitalAgriculture #QualityAssurance #qualityfoodforbillions

ANNAM.AI

🤝 Indian Institute of Technology, Ropar × ANNAM.AI × AGNEXT Technologies: Advancing AI-Driven Agriculture 🌾

A significant step towards strengthening innovation in agriculture as Indian Institute of Technology, Ropar, ANNAM.AI, and AGNEXT Technologies Private Limited formalized a tripartite Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) at the Indian Institute of Technology, Ropar.

The MoU was signed by Mr. Taranjeet Singh Bhamra, Chief Executive Officer, AGNEXT Technologies Private Limited, and Prof. Pushpendra P. Singh, Project Director at ANNAM.AI, Indian Institute of Technology, Ropar, marking a collaborative effort towards the development, dissemination, field-level adoption, and implementation of AI-driven technologies and digital solutions in agriculture and allied domains.

The discussions also explored technology participation, potential implementation opportunities, and the roadmap ahead for advancing research, technology development, and quality assurance.

🌱 From research and technology to real-world agricultural applications - building solutions for a smarter, more connected future.

𝗪𝗲 𝗮𝘀𝗸𝗲𝗱. 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗮𝗻𝘀𝘄𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗱.

50% of you said the same thing: "𝗖𝗹𝗮𝗶𝗺𝘀 𝗯𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗲𝗱 𝗯𝘆 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗹 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗮."

Not fancier packaging. Not louder marketing. 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗼𝗳.

The regulator agrees. 150+ notices have gone out to food and beverage companies over misleading ads, unsupported claims and labelling violations. Global FMCG majors. Energy drink makers. QSR chains. Quick-commerce platforms. Nobody was too big.

The message is now unmistakable: a marketing claim must survive scientific scrutiny. Packaging is no longer advertising copy — it is regulated consumer information.

So the real question for brand and quality teams isn't "is our claim compliant?"

It's: 𝗰𝗮𝗻 𝘄𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘂𝗹𝘁, 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗯𝗮𝘁𝗰𝗵, 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗿, 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗿𝗼𝘃𝗮𝗹 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗹 𝗯𝗲𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗰𝗹𝗮𝗶𝗺 — 𝗶𝗻 𝗺𝗶𝗻𝘂𝘁𝗲𝘀?

That gap is exactly what 𝗔𝗴𝗡𝗲𝘅𝘁 𝗔𝘀𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 closes:

→ Supplier onboarding, audits and qualification on one system
→ Raw material and finished product testing, sample-to-result, tracked live
→ Lot-level traceability from source to shelf
→ Non-conformance → root cause → CAPA → validated closure
→ One searchable audit trail across inspection, testing and incidents

Your consumers just told you what earns their trust. Your regulator just told you what protects your licence. Same answer.

𝗖𝗹𝗮𝗶𝗺𝘀 𝗱𝗼𝗻'𝘁 𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝗯𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗰𝗼𝗽𝘆𝘄𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀. 𝗧𝗵𝗲𝘆 𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝗯𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗿𝗱𝘀.

Book a discovery call. We'll map your quality workflow and show you exactly where the evidence gaps sit.

𝗚𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗳𝘂𝗹 𝘁𝗼 𝗯𝗲 𝗳𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝗻 𝗗𝗗 𝗡𝗲𝘄𝘀 — 𝗡𝗲𝘅𝘁𝗚𝗲𝗻 𝗕𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘁.

Thank you to the 𝗗𝗗 𝗡𝗲𝘄𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗔𝗡𝗜 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺 for spotlighting how technology is reshaping Indian agriculture, and for giving space to the innovators building it.

At AgNext, our work sits at a simple idea: food and agri quality should be measurable, traceable and visible in real time - not locked in paper records, delayed lab reports and WhatsApp photos.

That idea only works because of the people behind it:

→ Our 𝗰𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗿𝘀 — FMCG brands, exporters, foodservice groups, banks and regulatory bodies - who trusted us with real quality problems and pushed us to build for the field, not the demo.
→ Our 𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗮𝘆𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀 across 25+ states, who make quality data real at the point where it matters.
→ Our 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿 𝗹𝗮𝗯𝗼𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗲𝘀, who keep the compliance backbone credible.
→ Our 𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀, for backing deep-tech in agri when the timelines are long.
→ And our 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺 𝗮𝘁 𝗔𝗴𝗡𝗲𝘅𝘁 — the engineers, data scientists, quality experts and field crews who turn a spectral reading into a decision someone can act on.

Special thanks to Rishabh Mookherjee and  the Asian News International (ANI) team for carrying the story further.

This feature belongs to all of them.

Plenty still left to build. 🇮🇳

𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗰𝗮𝗻'𝘁 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗱𝗼𝗻'𝘁 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲.

3,000+ inspections. 160+ licences suspended. 700+ improvement notices. That's not a forecast - that's the last few months of food safety enforcement in India.

Maharashtra FDA started it. FSSAI scaled it. Karnataka, Punjab, Kerala, Madhya Pradesh followed. Restaurants, dairies, cloud kitchens, dark stores, five-star hotels, quick-commerce warehouses — nobody got a pass.

Here's the uncomfortable part: most brands aren't failing on quality. They're failing on 𝗲𝘃𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲. The check happened. The record didn't.

An inspector doesn't ask if you're compliant. They ask you to prove it. Today.
And increasingly, so does the person buying your product. 

𝗦𝗼 𝘄𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝘀𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗽𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝘄𝗵𝗼 𝗮𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗲𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗼𝗱; 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗮𝘂𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀, 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗕𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗱𝘀. 𝗬𝗼𝘂.

Sparsh Kaur
2mo

Some moments are planned.
Some simply happen.
And some come as a beautiful surprise. ❤️

I was delighted to receive an invitation for the 'At Home' Reception at  Rashtrapati Bhavan for the Independence Day celebrations with the Hon’ble President of India.

My sincere gratitude to Hon’ble President Droupadi Murmu ji for this honour.

I feel particularly proud to be representing women entrepreneurship and AGNEXT — a company working every day to use technology and innovation to create a stronger, transparent and more efficient food systems for India.

There is something beautiful about celebrating Independence Day in a place that represents the country, surrounded by people who are contributing to India in so many different ways.

And the invitation itself deserves a special mention. Beautifully crafted and thoughtfully designed, it was a lovely representation of India’s rich handicraft tradition. Holding it felt like holding a little piece of India’s incredible craftsmanship and heritage in my hands.

Tomorrow, I’ll be there with immense gratitude, pride and a little bit of excitement too. 

What a wonderful way to celebrate India.
Jai Hind! 🇮🇳

Recent hygiene lapses across quick-commerce operations highlight a larger challenge: as food supply chains scale, 𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗺𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝘀𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗲 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗺.

Quality, hygiene, traceability and compliance cannot sit across disconnected records and systems. Businesses need one trusted view of what is happening across every lot, material and location.

𝗔𝗴𝗡𝗲𝘅𝘁 𝗔𝘀𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 acts as the Command Centre for food quality, traceability and compliance - creating a digital identity for every lot and continuously capturing quality, provenance and operational data.

Our Assurance Platform turns this into actionable intelligence, helping teams 𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗳𝘆 𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗸𝘀 𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗹𝘆 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗮𝘂𝗱𝗶𝘁-𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗲𝘃𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝘄𝗵𝗲𝗻 𝗶𝘁 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀.

Because in food, trust needs proof.
